About Canva
Making something look good used to require a design degree, a fancy laptop, and way too much time. Canva said nah — and honestly, we're grateful.
Canva is the world's most inclusive visual communications platform, built for everyone from solo creators to massive teams. Whether you're designing a thumbnail, a pitch deck, or something you didn't even know you needed — there are 500,000+ templates to get you started, and a whole lot of oh wow waiting at the other end.
